versions.content: In order to cancel pending transmission in lower-layer, related to the lower priority request, the Dcm module shall call PduR_DcmCancelTransmit () with the following parameters: PduId: the id of the Pdu to be canceled

If a protocol is preempted and this protocol has a running pend- ing response transmission, the Dcm shall call PduR_DcmCancelTransmit () for this transmission with the following parameters: PduId: the id of the Pdu to be canceled
